images.filename: Dunes at Son Bou Beach, Menorca.jpg
images.caption: Bathers feed the ducks and geese who come to the beach for the fresh water stream, pictured, which runs down from the hills inland towards the sand dunes of Son Bou beach where it mixes with the sea's salty water. Located on the south coast of the island, Son Bou is the longest sandy beach on Menorca and the entire island is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
images.alt: Bathers feed the ducks and geese who come to the beach for the fresh water stream, pictured, which runs down from the hills inland towards the sand dunes of Son Bou beach where it mixes with the sea's salty water. Located on the south coast of the island, Son Bou is the longest sandy beach on Menorca and the entire island is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
